subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters M, E, K, T, X and B are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the letter on the face opposite to E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca7e7d745f92a889c6510ecc4ffeeed0dc1d9ddbe8bf601fe621d8a8faba154.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As M is common on both the dices, it is clear that E, K, T, and X are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. B will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f17c7f7515e3c0087eee75fc512496d1bc1ec6076884bcb906bd0cd02b5461.png] 

Opposite pairs:

E → T

K → X

M → B

So, the opposite side of "E" will be side "T".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
